input-field.name: enableOrderExport
input-field.label: Send orders to Minimax (as draft invoices)
Aufträge an Minimax senden (als Rechnungsentwürfe)
input-field.helpText: Off by default. While off, the export still runs and logs the exact payload it would send, using read-only lookups only: nothing is created in Minimax, a customer that does not exist yet is listed as "WouldCreate".

input-field.name: endCustomerCode
input-field.label: Minimax customer for buyers without a VAT ID
Minimax-Kunde für Käufer ohne USt-IdNr.
input-field.helpText: Code of the shared Minimax customer every order without a VAT ID goes to; the buyer's name and address are still written on the document. Leave empty for "končni kupec". A buyer with a VAT ID is matched by tax number and created in Minimax when not found.

input-field.name: shippingItemCode
input-field.label: Minimax item for shipping costs (code or name)
Minimax-Artikel für Versandkosten (Code oder Name)
input-field.helpText: Code or exact name of the Minimax item every shipping row points to. Leave empty for "POŠTNINA". Which orders are exported is fixed: order state "Open"; card / online payments only once paid; cash on delivery, invoice and prepayment right away.

input-field.name: warehouseCode
input-field.label: Minimax warehouse (code or name)
Minimax-Lager (Code oder Name)
input-field.helpText: Warehouse every exported invoice row is taken from — stock is discharged straight from the invoice, as on the shop's till invoices. Leave empty for code "1" (Skladišče).

input-field.name: documentNumbering
input-field.label: Minimax invoice numbering (code or name)
Minimax-Rechnungsnummernkreis (Code oder Name)
input-field.helpText: Orders are filed as DRAFT issued invoices on this numbering series; staff issue (number and fiscalise) them in Minimax. Once issued, the invoice number is stored on the order and the order is set to Done. Leave empty for "WEB-02" (SPLETNA TRG. davčna blagajna).

input-field.name: paymentMethodCard
input-field.label: Card / online payments (Stripe, Google Pay, Apple Pay)
input-field.helpText: Exact name of the Minimax invoice payment method. Leave empty for "Kartica". Marked as already paid — these orders are only exported once paid.

input-field.name: paymentMethodPaypal
input-field.label: PayPal
input-field.helpText: Exact name of the Minimax invoice payment method. Leave empty for "Drugo".

input-field.name: paymentMethodCashOnDelivery
input-field.label: Cash on delivery
input-field.helpText: Exact name of the Minimax invoice payment method. Leave empty for "Gotovina po povzetju". Not yet paid when exported.

input-field.name: paymentMethodBankTransfer
input-field.label: Bank transfer (Predračun, prepayment, direct debit)
input-field.helpText: Exact name of the Minimax invoice payment method. Leave empty for "Transakcijski račun". Marked paid only if the shop payment is already paid when exported.
